decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The access doorway to the premises shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for Ayurveda therapy uses, shall not take place anywhere in the house except the 'treatment room' (area 13.2m2) as shown on drawing number KGS/GRE/294P2/1, received 12 October 2007, with the remainder of the house to be retained as a dwellinghouse for residential use only.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times, with only one person to be treated at any one time:9:30am to 4:30pm Monday to Saturday
Condition : 5 - Customers shall receive treatments/ therapies on an appointment basis only.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) (England) Regulations 2007 there shall no be no advertisement/s displaying the use of the one room of the dwellinghouse hereby permitted for Ayurveda therapy use unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Planning Use Classes Order as amended by the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) (Amendment) (England) Order 2005 the one room of the dwellinghouse hereby permitted for Ayurveda therapy use shall be used for no other purpose falling within Class D1 without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Change of use of one room to Ayurveda therapy use
